all_thresholds: Engineering acceptance targets for named smooth well-scaled benchmark cases; not universal experimental error guarantees.
comparison_rule: abs(actual-reference) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference) componentwise in declared reduced units unless a metric is explicitly stated.

cases.scope: analytic harmonic pair energy and forces
central finite-difference energy/force consistency
translation/rotation/permutation and net internal force/torque
cases.metric: normalized max residual; torque uses L0 and F0

cases.scope: constrained two-point harmonic relaxation
cases.additional: fixed coordinates identical; rest-distance reduced error <=1e-6; minimum not generally certified

cases.scope: zero potential discrete Dirichlet eigenvalues
weighted normalization and orthogonality
backward eigen residual
zero potential continuum energies; first 4 states; n=1023
cases.additional: Compared with alpha*(j*pi/B)^2 on exactly the same finite interval.

cases.scope: smooth benchmark second-order grid convergence 127,255,511
cases.additional: Skip p when the numerator/denominator is at <=100*eps*max(1,abs(E)); record roundoff-limited.

cases.scope: quadratic potential boundary and grid error separation
cases.metric: compare low-state energies with harmonic reference; keep dx constant when enlarging domain
cases.additional: Relative error target for first 4 states; n=1023 on [-8,8] and n=1279 on [-10,10] preserve spacing in oscillator length, alpha=0.5. Use the shifted xi center parameter.

cases.scope: revision immutability, replay, unit/scaling equivalence, finite-only exports
workflow source/patch/sweep validation and max expanded steps
idempotency and cancellation race state invariants
invalid domain, unsupported model, missing data and resource-limit diagnostics
Generic envelope admits a registered third representation without adding an A/B oneOf branch; actual executable support still requires complete registration.
Unknown module/version/representation, unregistered fields and unknown extensions fail closed after envelope validation.
Initial modules still require SI units, L0/E0 scales, strict system/numerics schemas and their own protocol limits.
Source aliases resolve to typed states and declared operation ports; wrong dimensions, units, time semantics or partial upstream states are rejected.
Text/config/image artifacts validate without array metadata; array artifacts require dtype, shape, unit, axis_order and precision.
Registry snapshots and result/state/schema versions survive replay without silent implementation substitution.
Mandatory core module result payloads and selected supported observables satisfy their registered schemas without forcing unrequested arrays.

contract_validation_scope: Static schema and contract checks may be executed separately, but every numerical or future runtime case below remains planned until its corresponding implementation is actually run.
